approaches.description: Extend the existing bounded conjunctive code-name lookup to ASCII alphabetic snake_case components. Keep ordinary exact phrase lookup first. Reject empty, numeric, short and generic components as whole names; preserve existing CamelCase behavior.

selection: Require development delivery gains with no per-fact rank/delivery regression, no negative record-ID changes or safety violations. Only score the fixed selected candidate on heldout. Historical source incidents are exposed; this is a constructed mechanism check, not blind semantic validation.
guards: All 792 older policy replays plus 160 complex and 16 retention policy replays preserve earlier outcomes.
Preserve each supplied primary and additional composed-answer fact and rank.
Negatives preserve returned IDs and order; unknown-symbol controls still abstain.
Keep caller visibility, trust, tags, repository scope, duplicate handling and packet limits.
No full-pool eviction, model weights, preprocessing, thresholds, stored claims, schemas or release assets change.
registration_serialization: JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) plus a final newline
